tool.fallback_python: trimesh + pyrender (or matplotlib Poly3DCollection) if Blender is unavailable

scene.cutaway: remove the two walls facing the camera; keep the others full height
scene.window: glass opening with a sill at 0.90 m and a head at 2.20 m
scene.lighting: sun through the windows plus a soft world light; same for every render

camera.framing: fit the unit bounding box with a 10% margin; same scale for every unit of similar size
